initial_time_pipeline.normalization: label-specific arcing-only /255 before feature extraction; no fold-fitted class-neutral scaler in the legacy reproduction

initial_frequency_pipeline.normalization: label-specific arcing-only /255 before feature extraction; no fold-fitted class-neutral scaler in the legacy reproduction

corrected_time_representation.normalization: RobustScaler fitted on training frames only, per Mel band; validation/test transformed with training statistics

corrected_frequency_representation.input: frequency-domain record stored as a 10,001-bin one-sided FFT magnitude
corrected_frequency_representation.mel_mapping: 128 triangular Mel bands over 0-5512.5 Hz on exact frequency axis
corrected_frequency_representation.shape: 128x1; Mel bands are sequence positions, not time frames
corrected_frequency_representation.normalization: RobustScaler fitted on training records only across 128 bands

corrected_fixed_split.selection: group-safe 70/15/15 candidate chosen only for size/class balance, never model performance

inner_validation.used: first inner split; fit preprocessing on inner-train only; checkpoint by minimum inner-validation weighted cross-entropy

uncertainty.method: identity-cluster percentile bootstrap on pooled OOF predictions after averaging probabilities over the two repetitions

near_duplicate_sensitivity.similarity: absolute centered cosine/Pearson correlation on full stored record (log1p magnitude for frequency)

timing_protocol.reported: median and 95th percentile; inference_mode; no data-loading time

conflict_policy.primary: retain contradictory exact groups but keep whole identity group in one partition
conflict_policy.sensitivity: exclude every exact group containing both labels; policy predeclared from identity+label only, not performance
